contents.description: A forest-understory and young-river route, built around one necessary narrow boardwalk, a survey-pond landing, a native low bank with western return, mature-pine circuit with a measured Cut shortcut, and a smaller southern fen loop. Original story/actor/item identities retained; no false cabin or mandatory field move.
